verdict.rationale: Independent users confirm LaunchDarkly ships multivariate flags; one team uses them to serve non-boolean batch-size values (1MB/5MB/10MB). First-party docs in the pack only say targeting rules 'serve flag variations' and never document the supported variation types. missing for 10: first-party documentation of string, number, and JSON flag variation types, evidence of serving JSON or dynamic configuration payloads, and SDK typed-evaluation docs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: They use multivariate flags to throttle agent data batch sizes (1MB/5MB/10MB).
use flag targeting rules to serve flag variations to different contexts based on their attributes
